integrity: The proof separates the cited \(\tau\)-fixed-bitangent count from the new order-three invariant-line argument, and the finite algebraic checks are reproducible from the bundled checker.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the marked \(\mu_6\) subgroup, not the full automorphism group on the special \(a=0\) locus; no arithmetic Galois-orbit claim is made.
title: The marked \(\mu_6\)-action on bielliptic Picard bitangents has orbit type \(1+3+4\cdot6\)
